# GaiaWorks | Core Use Cases

| Use case | Description |
| --- | --- |
| Production line time | The main link is used for “entry of personnel or candidate data - rules or approval processing - self-help of staff managers - results into reports or downstream systems”. It is recommended to record the length of processing, the anomaly rate, the number of manual corrections, the mobile end completion rate, statutory or institutional differences and the cost per employee. |
| Cost sharing for property projects | Main link certification of property project costs is shared with “People or candidate data entry - rules or approval processing - self-help for staff managers - result entry reports or downstream systems”. It is recommended to record the length of processing, the anomaly rate, the number of manual corrections, the mobile end completion rate, statutory or institutional differences and the cost per employee. |
| Service centre capacity plan | The master link to validate the centre capacity of the passenger service is used as the “people or candidate data entry - rules or approval processing - employee manager self-help - results into the report or downstream system”. It is recommended to record the length of processing, the anomaly rate, the number of manual corrections, the mobile end completion rate, statutory or institutional differences and the cost per employee. |
